$comment: Representative corpus for every TextMate language the editor catalog ships. The backend suite tokenizes each fixture through the served catalog with the vendored engine; the visionOS render suite pushes the same catalog into the real editor page and reads the same tokens back. An `expect` entry names a 0-based line, the exact text of one token on it, and scope names that token's scope list must contain. An `expectLanguage` entry names the Monaco language id the token's encoded metadata must carry, which only the page can check.
